title: AuthRequest
description: A prior authorization request event delivered to the prior auth agent.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this authorization request.

patient_id.description: Patient identifier in the EHR system.

provider_id.description: Ordering provider NPI or internal identifier.

procedure_code.description: CPT or HCPCS procedure code being requested.

diagnosis_codes.description: ICD-10 diagnosis codes supporting medical necessity.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the request was submitted.
